name: Vampire - Shapechanger - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: His body convulses but resists, trapped between forms in agony.
A searing pain shoots through his veins as the change fails.
His flesh twitches, but the shadows refuse to answer his call.
A hollow laugh echoes as the transformation sputters and fades.
The air grows heavy with dread as his form remains unyielding.
